rationale.consistency: Uses prShared alias, Copy()+RepoDir, ctx.Background(), cmdutil.FlagErrorf/MutuallyExclusive and git client method style matching the codebase; new git methods mirror WorktreeRemove.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles blank path, missing --checkout, --list conflict, relative->absolute, reuse-of-existing-worktree, existing vs new local branch, remote chosen from branchRepo, ff-only pull warning; no-remote early return preserved.
rationale.scope: Core move to shared package is required, but adds an unused WorktreeCheckoutCommands helper and silently rewrites checkout's localBranchExists to HasLocalBranch, neither asked for.
rationale.readability: Clear names, small checkoutWorktree with commented branches, extracted warnFastForwardFailure; doc comments carried over intact.
rationale.robustness: Errors propagated at each git step, Abs errors handled, symlink/non-dir guard retained and applied to the absolute path; validation runs before any API mutation.
rationale.maintainability: Shared WorktreeTarget struct is a good seam, but WorktreeCheckoutCommands duplicates command logic already in cmdsForExistingRemote and is dead in production, and develop implements the same branching a third way via client methods.
